subject.title: Unify split-view controls into one toolbar row

question: Should Control UI replace the global breadcrumb row with active split-pane controls when split view is active, and move the classic split-view entry action out of the composer?
rationale: The source confirms the current duplicated chrome, but changing the global toolbar ownership and composer action placement is a visible Control UI product decision on a protected maintainer-labeled issue.

options.title: Sponsor toolbar unification
options.body: Accept the requested direction and require a focused Control UI implementation with responsive/e2e proof for split, classic, narrow, and drag/drop paths.

options.title: Keep current ownership
options.body: Leave breadcrumbs and pane headers separate if maintainers prefer explicit route chrome and per-pane controls over reclaiming vertical space.

options.title: Narrow the change
options.body: Move only the classic split-view entry button out of the composer and defer split-pane toolbar consolidation until there is broader shell guidance.

recommendation.title: Sponsor toolbar unification
recommendation.body: Accept the requested direction and require a focused Control UI implementation with responsive/e2e proof for split, classic, narrow, and drag/drop paths.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the split-view product context and authored the linked foundation work, while the topbar owner can review the shell details after the direction is chosen.
